Quick Start

  1. Use File → Import MVR... to open an MVR, or start a new project and add scene elements. Create from Text can turn a rider into a starting scene.
  2. Review placement and orientation in the 2D and 3D views.
  3. Optionally open the read-only MVR / GDTF Inspector to examine package content and fixture definitions.
  4. Review and edit the Fixtures, Trusses, Hoists and Objects tables. Check fixture types, DMX modes, patch and positions.
  5. Save your work as a .pstg project so you can continue editing later.
  6. Export MVR for exchange, or prepare Layouts and PDF for printing and sharing.

If profiles are missing, see GDTF Download. See Preferences for units and import settings, and Troubleshooting for runtime problems.
